parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA
parsed.notes: Figures taken from the Calculation of Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation table (in millions) for the first quarter of fiscal 2026 (ended December 27, 2025) and the prior-year quarter (ended December 28, 2024). Both figures exclude Hawthorne, which is reported as a discontinued operation. No year-to-date or full-year figures beyond the quarter are shown.
